canonical_statement: The physical universe is governed by consistent physical laws, such as gravity, rather than astral influences.

attributions.surface_quote: Gravity rules (or did), not astral ‘influence.’

canonical_statement: Celestial configurations at birth contain the potentialities of an individual's life trajectory.

attributions.surface_quote: things in heaven foreshadow things on earth

canonical_statement: Celestial phenomena function as a linguistic medium used by the divine for communication with angelic beings.

attributions.surface_quote: Star-talk is the medium in which God commands his angels.

canonical_statement: The celestial order operates as a coded system of signs analogous to natural language.

attributions.surface_quote: signs of star-talk function... in the same way as natural languages

canonical_statement: The celestial movements function as a semiotic system of signs that convey meaning.

attributions.surface_quote: the heavens are meaningful, in the literal sense

canonical_statement: The primary purpose of celestial motion is the maintenance of the universal structure.

attributions.surface_quote: movement of the stars is for the preservation of the universe

canonical_statement: Future events are encoded in the patterns of celestial bodies and can be decoded via analogy.

attributions.surface_quote: read the future from their patterns... use of analogy

canonical_statement: Planetary deities possess autonomous existence and internal purposes independent of human affairs.

attributions.surface_quote: planetary god has its own life... nothing to do with us

canonical_statement: The influence of higher beings on humans is a secondary, incidental effect rather than a primary objective.

attributions.surface_quote: action on us... is always something incidental

canonical_statement: A daimon is a spiritual entity existing in an intermediate state between divinity and humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: daimôn is a spirit... intermediate between a god and a human

canonical_statement: Every human individual possesses a personal spiritual projection on a supernatural plane.

attributions.surface_quote: Each one of us has his or her own daimôn

canonical_statement: The supernatural plane is characterized by a polarity of light and dark forces acting as guardians.

attributions.surface_quote: one on the dark side... and one on the light

canonical_statement: Celestial bodies are characterized by anthropomorphic and gendered attributes.

attributions.surface_quote: the anthropomorphic and thus necessarily gendered planets

canonical_statement: Celestial configurations exert a flowing influence upon terrestrial existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Influence... means that which flows in from the surrounding heavens.

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a process of descent and return through planetary spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: descent and return of the soul through the planetary spheres
